title: Hey Listen - Follow a sound wherever it goes
description: A free, open-source desktop app for exploring sound - open, shape, and visualize any audio on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
heroHeading: Follow a sound wherever it goes.
heroSubheading: Pick a song, a room, a voice. Shape it, watch it, and get to know it a little better.

features.title: Start anywhere
features.text: A file, the mic, the system, one app, or a mix - plus a way to make up a sound of your own.

features.title: Explore the views
features.text: Two dozen ways to see a sound - waveform, spectrum, spectrogram, pitch, tempo, loudness, and more. Arrange them however you like.

features.title: Shape the sound
features.text: Build a little graph to change the tone, then switch it on and off to hear the difference it makes.

features.title: Let an agent drive
features.text: Hand the running app to an AI assistant over MCP. It opens sources, runs tools, edits graphs, previews playback, and saves projects on the window you're watching.

features.title: Keep the whole thing
features.text: Everything - the audio, the source, the graphs, the layout - saved in one file, ready to reopen. Keep several projects side by side.

features.title: Analyze in bulk
features.text: hey-listen analyze runs with no window at all. Feed it a batch of files, get one JSON result per file, and pipe it straight into your scripts or CI.

features.title: Annotate as you listen
features.text: Leave a markdown note on any moment - a point or a span - straight from a chart. Each note keeps the values it was written against and shows up as a marker on every other view.

downloadNote: Free and public domain - macOS, Windows, and Linux.
ossLine: Proudly open source - released under the Unlicense, so it's yours to use, change, and share.
footerLine: Hey Listen is in the public domain (Unlicense).
